name: Roy Cooper
subject: What it’s going to take
body:
Let me explain why it’s so important that I can count on you today.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1443&source=&t=1&akid=3937%2E124072%2Eell4JS) | | | |
---
Peter,
In light of our last quarterly FEC fundraising deadline comping up in just over 48 hours, I’m asking you to make your first donation to my Senate campaign in North Carolina. If that’s all you need to hear, please use this link to chip in: [**_https: //secure.actblue.com/donate/cvf-email-26_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1443&amount=5&t=8&akid=3937%2E124072%2Eell4JS)
Otherwise, let me explain why it’s so important that you do – and especially today.
By giving $5, you’ll join the hundreds of thousands of folks who have claimed a stake in our grassroots movement with their donations.
By giving $5, you’ll be declaring your membership in the fight for working families and that you refuse to stand by and watch a Washington DC insider and former Big Oil and utility company lobbyist buy this seat.
**By giving $5, most critically, you’ll help us reach our can’t-miss fundraising goals – including the $5 million target we need to hit by Wednesday night.**
We didn’t land on that number arbitrarily, Peter. It was carefully calculated to ensure we have what we need to fight back against the GOP dark-money groups pouring more than $100 million so far into attacking me. **So if we come up short, it could endanger our chances of flipping this seat.**
Now, I know not everyone can give to every email. But with Senate control riding on this race – and a shortfall to make up by the end of the day – I hope I can count on you to give to this one.
[**_So please, will you make your first contribution of $5 now – or anything you can spare – to help us close the gap, win North Carolina’s race and take back the Senate for Democrats?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1443&amount=5&t=9&akid=3937%2E124072%2Eell4JS) | _If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | [DONATE $5](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14275?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1443&amount=5&t=10&akid=3937%2E124072%2Eell4JS)

Thank you,

Roy Cooper

Please note, if you have given through a spouse or another email or phone number, our records may not have transferred that information here. We are grateful for your support and no further action is required at this time._
| |
* * *

Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

Carmela Conroy claims she never said she would “behead” the Department of Homeland Security.There’s just one problem. She did.**Roll the tape.**
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/j0oOmMv2r1E?e=5a45b9550e&c2id=b2f1dd870633a757190c0f1edbcab238)
| |
Carmela Conroy, in her own words, called on Congress to “dismantle and behead” the Department of Homeland Security.Now she’s insisting she didn’t say it. (Does she not remember?!) But her dishonesty isn’t the main issue – the substance behind those words matters even more.DHS is responsible for securing our border and enforcing our immigration laws. It also includes the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) that provides aid to areas stricken by wildfires and other natural disasters.And she wants to behead it. You can imagine how people in Washington, D.C. react to that insulting, irresponsible language. Thankfully, I am working to make sure that our federal aid request is on track.(In addition to beheading DHS, Conroy also proposed a bizarre plan – and I’m not making this up – to empty illegal immigrant detention centers so illegal aliens could help fund Social Security, saying illegals “...all contribute to it.”)That isn't a minor policy disagreement. And it isn't something voters should have to discover by watching an old clip after being told it never happened.[Carmela said it. The tape shows it.](https://us.list-manage.com/Z0RMV8iuJSp?e=5a45b9550e&c2id=b2f1dd870633a757190c0f1edbcab238)I walked out of our last debate just shaking my head. Where does she get these ideas? When we are asking the federal government for disaster relief, I can only describe her actions as undiplomatic, to say the least.-Michael

| | Good Afternoon Team Demuth!
**Zoom Meeting**
I want to remind everyone that we will have our regularly scheduled grassroots volunteer meeting tonight at 8:30 PM. We will talk about yard signs, volunteer efforts, updates on Right Insight, some events coming up, and much much more!
I have placed the link below and I have turned off the password function on the Zoom Meeting since we had some trouble with it during last Thursday’s meeting. Once you click the link, you will be taken into a waiting room. I will let you into the meeting from there.
https://us06web.zoom.us/j/87316568944
**Update on Right Insight**
During the meeting, Caleb will be giving an update on door-knocking and phone-calling. This is a fantastic way to help out our campaign. **Even five minutes of phone calling, or door knocking even just your neighbors goes an incredibly long way!**
All of you that have previously been volunteers already have accounts. Simply download the app and sign in using the email address you received this message at. You will be sent a six-digit code to verify your identity, then you’re all logged in and ready to roll!For door knocking, we are utilizing a feature called Near Me. This will allow volunteers to go out and door knock houses that are nearby them. That list will change as you move around, so you can use it anywhere.Calls will be broken down by Congressional District. When we add you to Right Insight, we will assign you to calls specific for your area so you are talking to people who you may know, or share more common issues. Most of you will likely see all of them until we are able to organize you into Congressional district teams, so please just call into the CD you are from. For example, if you are from CD 1, call CD1.**If you do login and are told you do not have an account, please fill out the form below and we will get you added!**[ Sign up for a Right Insight Account.](https://us.list-manage.com/YRuwz7sZAPG?e=422536b04e&c2id=3f96188058f7a1407b5cde0c924e7fd7)Both calls and door knocking projects are live and ready for volunteers. We are very excited to get everyone started! If you have technical questions or are unsure of how to get started, please call Caleb at 612-300-4202 or email him at Caleb@mngop.com**4x8’ Signs** As we begin to ramp down on sign distribution, we are currently analyzing where we would like to place a limited number of 4x8’ signs. If you have a location for a 4x8’ sign, please send the address along with any other relevant information to Logan Peterson. My number and email are listed below. I have a couple of guidelines for this. 4x8’ signs are extremely large and they are the only signs that are truly visible at high speeds. Therefore, the minimum speed for a roadway next to a 4x8’ sign should be at least 55 mph. Any slower and a 2x4’ sign will work just fine. If your address is not chosen to receive a 4x8’ please keep in mind that although we would love for everyone in the state to receive a 4x8’ we have incredibly high demand due to enthusiasm for the campaign.We look forward to seeing everyone on the call tonight! Thank you for joining us. With your help, we will elect Lisa Demuth as our next Governor and restore common sense to Minnesota.

Friends, Another thing I hear from people across our district is how closely **jobs and housing** are connected. Someone finds a good job, but can’t find a place nearby they can afford. A senior wants to stay in the community they’ve called home for decades, but there aren’t enough options. **A good job doesn’t mean much if you can’t afford to live where the job is. That’s why housing is part of Opportunity at Home.** In 2021, Congress passed the American Rescue Plan, sending federal dollars directly to communities to address local needs. **Pete Stauber voted against it.
